scientific_integrity: Exact rational checker reproduces 18 finite cases; analytic proof treats every dimension and real closing-edge length in scope. All publicly stated conclusions concern self-review, not external certification.
scientific_limitations: The exact volume formula is not novel; finite exact tests are corroboration and do not prove the infinite theorem. Functional convergence with conditioning is stated only when the slab event has positive limiting probability. Non-Gaussian inverse-covariance sparsity is not conditional independence. Possible unindexed equivalent moment evaluations remain.
title: Exact precision and critical Brownian crossover for one-defect cycle Lipschitz balls
